model_notes: Subcontractor change order proposal/authorization from Delmar Electric Co. to Hallmark General Contractors for EV charging work. The change itself is the GC-approved amount of $81,640.55 (proposed total was $85,087.00; line items and subtotals are parts). Previous and revised subcontract values bracket the change ($1,946,300.00 + $81,640.55 = $2,027,940.55). Time extension 4 working days granted vs 6 requested.
